title: relay on other harnesses (pi) and any provider
what: An idea for later: one harness-neutral core plus a thin adapter per harness (.claude, .pi, ...), with free choice of provider. Assessment in ~/.relay/backup/scratch-3207dc59/reports/harness-port.md: 45% of relay's Python is harness-neutral, 26% mixed, 26% Claude-only; pi 1.4.0 maps the hook events almost one to one (blocking a tool call, stop), lacks typed subagents with turn limits, plugin eval, CLAUDE.local.md and permissions; 870-1300 agent minutes (estimate) plus double upkeep. Cheapest proof: measure provider choice inside Claude Code first (~60 min).
why: Owner, 26 Oct, verbatim: "Пока это просто идея на будущее, до неё ещё далеко, насколько сложно будет перенести relay с claude на pi и свободный выбор провайдера, при этом унифицировав подход с дополнительной обвязкой для каждого harness (.claude, .pi and etc.)". IP left 0 for the owner to set.
